name: enable_parallel
meaning: Use Rayon for source analysis and tier rendering.

name: budget_tokens
meaning: Maximum tokens in the complete serialized artifact. Must be positive.

name: focus_query
meaning: Task description used for lexical relevance and personalized ranking.

name: focus_files
meaning: Paths, filenames, directories, or globs to favor. Matching does not guarantee inclusion.

name: exclude_patterns
meaning: Repository-relative ignore::overrides globs without a leading exclusion marker.

name: respect_gitignore
meaning: Honor Git exclusion rules. Language-specific exclusions still apply when disabled.

name: redact_secrets
meaning: Redact recognized secret types before parsing, preserving byte offsets and line breaks. Detection does not cover every possible secret.

name: max_file_size_bytes
meaning: Source and manifest read limit in bytes. Must be positive.

name: allow_token_estimates
meaning: Permit estimated pipeline counts. The current tokenizer counts exactly without a fallback.
